## 4. Conclusion

In this study; we have proposed UAV based remote sensing framework to monitor and estimate growth of tassel which gives information about different growth stages heading(start of emergence of tassel), DFPT of the maize crop. A CNN based F-RCNN and YOLO models are evaluated for tassel detection from its emergence to reproduc tion stage. F-RCNN with FI score 0.909 provides better detection compared to YOLO which has Fl score of 0.878. Hence, F-RCNN has been used to estimate the heading and DFPT stages of maize crop. From the performance analysis it can be concluded that a UAV based remote sensing frame work using F-RCNN can be an alternative way for manual observation of different growth stages of maize crop.
